offering_description.value: Owns and operates oil refineries that process crude oil into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, heating oil, lubricants and petrochemical feedstocks. Sells these refined products to wholesale, commercial, and industrial customers and through bulk and spot markets. Also runs related logistics assets such as terminals, pipelines and rail facilities.

primary_products.value: gasoline; diesel fuel; jet fuel; heating oil; lubricants and petrochemical feedstocks

primary_services.value: crude and product terminalling; pipeline and rail logistics; storage

customer_segment.value: B2B: wholesale fuel marketers, distributors, airlines, commercial and industrial buyers, trading companies and petrochemical customers; B2G: some government and military fuel purchasers

end_markets.value: transportation fuels; aviation; heating; petrochemicals; industrial lubricants

revenue_model.value: product sales: refined petroleum products sold at market-based prices via contracts and spot sales; service fees: logistics fees for terminalling, storage, pipeline and rail services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: refines purchased crude and feedstocks into fuels and other petroleum products sold to wholesale and commercial buyers; asset operator: operates refineries, terminals, pipelines and rail assets

geography_served.value: US national: Refineries on East Coast, Gulf Coast, Midwest and West Coast, sells mainly across the US with some exports

specialization.value: related lines: refining of fuels and lubricants plus related logistics assets

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contract and spot sales to wholesale, commercial, and industrial customers and airlines; other: pipelines, rail, barges and terminals delivering product to bulk and spot markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Refineries need environmental permits, EPA Clean Air Act, Renewable Fuel Standard, state air regulators such as CARB, and OSHA process safety rules apply

notes: Logistics arm (PBF Logistics) was acquired and taken private, so logistics assets are now part of the company; this is from memory and refinery count and details may have changed.
